the tea for cheap price.
Quickly I must be preparing a ship

very much cargo, yes.

anymore, I am a little bit lonely.
But you, if you are traveler, maybe someday
somewhere we can meet again, yes.
Ah, you are
What is the matter?
Ah, I understand!
You are sad because I go home, and so
you came to say goodbye, yes?
Here's a parting gift from me. Take it.

en: Gyaaaaaaah!
Sorry, but your trip home will have to wait a while.
Do you do some kind of work?
I can't afford it. Sorry.
Is that so? Yes, of course.
is there something you are needing?
Well, I'd love some nice, tasty blood.
Eh!?
What is it you said just now?
Oh, no, I misspoke.
I'd love a drink of some nice wine.
Hmm, taking orders from a whelp like you
does not sit well, but it can't be helped

en: Hmm, taking orders
And who might you be?
Do you realize it's Dellwald
you're speaking to?
I am the jeweler
Hapst Dellwald.
I'll thank you not to be so familiar.
Look here, I'm in a hurry to get somewhere.
Kindly stay out of my way.
Oh, it's you.
Still, what a strange name that is.
I am the jeweler
I told you, I won't have you being so familiar.
Impertinent fellow.
(You're the impertinent one.)
I'm on my way home.
Isn't it about time you bought a jewel?
I'll be looking forward to it.
Did you come here knowing this is
the Dellwald house?
This is no house for the likes of you
to just drop in on.
Now, off you go.
How tiresome. Off with you, and be quick.
Barging in on me at my own home is a nuisance.
Kindly leave.

or

you've a sharp tongue, but decent stock.
